t1_scope_rule: T1 mandatory 5 files must be displayed line by line in bounded chunks (each shown range <=150 lines) via codegraph node --file/--offset/--limit --path C:/AgentSessions/Github_src/ctx; a hash alone never counts as reading; integrations/mcp.rs and upgrade/install.rs are full, while daemon.rs/main.rs/slash_commands.rs are explicitly partial with missing_ranges; supplementary files are counted only for ranges actually displayed; grep/AST outputs are not counted as read lines.
line_count_method: UTF-8 splitlines via PowerShell Get-Content; 1-based inclusive ranges; a trailing newline does not create an extra logical line (codegraph file-mode reports one extra virtual EOF line, excluded here).
hash_method: SHA-256 over raw file bytes; sha256_initial recorded before report writing; sha256_final re-verified after both deliverables were written.

T2 sweep-ctx.json was queried by file/probe filter only and is not counted as reading. No build/test/install/network/git-write was performed; commit identity was verified by reading .git/HEAD and .git/refs/heads/main (read-only), not by running git.
